# @alexify/mailer

> Zero-dependency email for Node.js, maintained by Alexis Technologies. Its own SMTP client, MIME
> builder, DKIM signing and HTTP providers (starting with Amazon SES v2), with a reliability layer
> on top that none of the common Node.js email libraries has: a persistent queue and outbox, an
> audit log, one model of delivery events, suppression and idempotency.

Key facts:
- Status: 1.0 is the transport layer, ported from upyo 0.7.0 (MIT); the reliability layer
  (queue, audit log, delivery events) is being designed and is not released yet
- Package (npm): `@alexify/mailer`, installed with `npm install @alexify/mailer`
- Node.js >= 22 only; CommonJS with ESM named-import interop; hand-written d.ts per entry
- Zero runtime dependencies: the transports are built on `node:*` modules and `fetch`; the
  OpenTelemetry providers, the logger and the drivers of a queue or a database are passed in
- Root entry `@alexify/mailer`: `createMessage`, the `Transport` contract, receipts,
  attachments, calendar parts, Message-ID helpers
- Subpaths: `/mime` (MIME, DKIM), `/smtp`, `/jmap`, `/ses`, `/resend`, `/sendgrid`, `/mailgun`,
  `/mailtrap`, `/maileroo`, `/lettermint`, `/plunk`, `/pool`, `/retry`, `/otel`, `/logger`, `/mock`
- Guide: https://mailerat.vercel.app/guide/getting-started
- API: https://mailerat.vercel.app/api/exports
- Comparison with 14 alternatives (Nodemailer, emailjs, Upyo, unemail, sently, provider SDKs):
  https://mailerat.vercel.app/guide/comparison
